notes.title: Harmonium released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we released a new game, Harmonium!

Harmonium is a point & click game, in which you'll have to manage your team and make choices to resolves different kinds of events and guide your town through a post-post-apocalyptic setting. 
Its gameplay is close to the one of Tavernier!

Check it out here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/712890/Harmonium/

And it's on sale for its first week ! ;)

notes.title: French Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone !
Tavernier has been updated with some new stuff :
-Some few bugs have been fixed, including the cave tooltips and sounds.
-A new language have been released ! You can now play Tavernier in French !
Thanks for playing our game, see you soon ;)
